title: 让科学图表讲述故事：基于论文的图表视频生成
summary: 提出MINARD管线，从科学图表和论文生成带旁白、区域定位的讲解视频。发布FigTalk基准，包含新评估指标。MINARD在自动和人工评估中优于现有方法。
summary_en: Proposes MINARD pipeline to generate narrated, region-grounded walkthrough videos from scientific figures and their papers. Releases FigTalk benchmark with new grounding metrics. Outperforms existing approaches in automatic and human evaluations.
